book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: ولد عمره تسع سنين اشتغل عند إسكافي بالمدينة.
sentences.en: A boy of nine worked for a shoemaker in the city.

sentences.ar: بليلة عيد، قعد لحاله وأخذ ورقة وقلم.
sentences.en: On a feast night, he sat alone and took paper and pen.

sentences.ar: كتب: يا جدي، تعال خدني من هون.
sentences.en: He wrote: grandfather, come and take me from here.
They beat me and make me sleep in the passage.

sentences.ar: كتب عن الضيعة وعن الكلب وعن التلج.
sentences.en: He wrote about the village and the dog and the snow.

sentences.ar: وقال: أنا رح أدعي لك طول عمري.
sentences.en: And he said: I will pray for you all my life.
He folded the paper and put it in an envelope.
He wrote on the envelope: to my grandfather in the village.

sentences.ar: ركض عالصندوق ورماها فيه وهو فرحان.
sentences.en: He ran to the postbox and dropped it in, happy.
He came back and slept waiting for a reply.
